## How It Works

### Step 1: Connect Your Systems
CXM integrates with your existing CRM (VIN Solutions, eLead, DriveCentric) and DMS. All your customer data, lead data, and vehicle information flows in. Nothing migrates — CXM reads and writes to what you already have.

### Step 2: Define Your Process
Use the visual workflow editor to build your lead handling process. Drag and drop: lead arrives → AI verification call → text on day 2 → email on day 3 → human callback on day 5. Assign AI personas or human agents to each step.

### Step 3: Choose Your Interface
Pick from ~20 UI themes: Outlook for your GM, Discord for your BDC team, a social feed for your sales floor, Power BI for your analytics team. Same data underneath — different experience on top.

### Step 4: Let It Run
AI watchers monitor every interaction. Appointments get scheduled automatically. Tasks get completed. CRM gets updated. Every night, the system reviews every open opportunity and flags anything that needs attention.

## Feature Deep Dives

### Unified Conversation Timeline
Every touchpoint with a customer in chronological order. Phone calls with transcripts. Text messages. Emails. AI voice interactions. Notes from CRM. No switching tabs, no searching across systems.

### Real-Time Call Intelligence
See every live call happening across your dealership right now. Real-time word-by-word transcription. Live listen capability. QA scoring as the call happens — not hours later.

### Configurable AI Voice Agents
Build named AI personas with specific voices, personalities, and behavioral rules. Sarah handles BDC. William handles lead verification. Jenny handles reception. Each one follows your process, your way.

### Visual Workflow Builder
No-code drag-and-drop process editor. Define what happens at each step of the customer journey — and whether an AI agent or a human handles it. Supports branching logic, time delays, and conditional triggers.

### AI Task Automation
After every call, AI reviews the conversation: Was an appointment set? Schedule it. Did the customer request a callback? Create the task. Was a trade mentioned? Flag it. Was the task already completed? Mark it done. Runs continuously.

### Smart PII Redaction
Every call transcript is processed through context-aware redaction. Credit card numbers get removed. Social Security numbers get beeped. But an employer's address stays — because it's not sensitive PII. Powered by medical-grade Assembly AI.

### Campaign Management
Toggle campaigns on and off. Run a service drive blitz. Execute a conquest campaign. Target specific lead segments. All from within CXM, all feeding back to your CRM.

### Multi-Device Deployment
iOS native app. Apple TV for showroom dashboards. Web browser for desktop. Same platform, same data, accessible from wherever your team works.

## FAQ

**Q: Does CXM replace my CRM?**
A: No. CXM sits on top of your CRM. All actions in CXM push back to your CRM — calls logged as calls, tasks completed, appointments scheduled. Your CRM stays your system of record.

**Q: What does "free" mean?**
A: Any dealer using any CarBot service gets CXM at no additional cost. There's no trial period, no feature gates, and no per-seat charges for the platform itself. Paid value-add services (custom integrations, dedicated AI persona development) are available separately.

**Q: Which CRMs does it integrate with?**
A: VIN Solutions, eLead, and DriveCentric are confirmed. Additional CRM integrations are available through custom development.

**Q: Can I choose different interfaces for different team members?**
A: Yes. ~20 UI themes are available. Each user can select the interface that works best for them. The underlying data and capabilities are identical across all themes.

**Q: How does the AI know what to do after a call?**
A: AI watchers analyze the call transcript in real time. If an appointment was set, it gets scheduled. If a follow-up was requested, a task gets created. If the lead needs to move to a new stage, it moves. Rules are defined in your workflow — AI executes them.

**Q: Is my data secure?**
A: CXM is built on the same architecture that powers ClearMed, CarBot's HIPAA-compliant healthcare AI. All calls include PII redaction. All telephony includes 10DLC, CNAM, and STIR/SHAKEN verification. SSO is supported for enterprise deployment.

**Q: Can this run on a TV in the showroom?**
A: Yes. CXM deploys natively to Apple TV and iOS devices. Put a live call dashboard on your sales floor TV or your manager's iPad.

**Q: What if we're not ready for AI?**
A: Start with the communication view. See all your calls, texts, and emails in one place. The AI capabilities are there when you're ready — but CXM is valuable even as a pure visibility tool.
